blocks.text:
Your final morning begins with breakfast at sunrise. You will then visit Daphne Major, where a major scientific research project is under way. Scientists have identified and banded every finch on the island, monitoring the birds and studying their habitat.

After the excursion, you will return to the yacht for a refreshing juice. The vessel then sails to Baltra Island. After disembarking, you will be transferred to the airport for your flight to the mainland.
